/* file : MakeMetaModelSchedulerMapper.xml, id : getMakeModelDoingList */
SELECT U.*, B.USER_PPRCS_FULL_STNG_VALUE FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL U LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_META_ETC_USER_ITEM B ON U.ETC_MODEL_SEQ = B.ETC_MODEL_SEQ WHERE U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.MODEL_STATUS = 'WAIT' ORDER BY MDFCN_DT ASC, U.ETC_MODEL_SEQ ASC LIMIT #{limitCnt}

/* file : MakeMetaModelSchedulerMapper.xml, id : setMakeModelOutputColumns */ SELECT * FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_COLUMN WHERE ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{etc_model_seq} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND MODEL_COL_TP = 'OC'

/* file : MakeMetaModelSchedulerMapper.xml, id : setMakeModelParams */ SELECT * , (SELECT T.MODEL_ALGRM FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_ALGRM T WHERE T.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ = A.MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' AND T.DEL_YN = 'N') MODEL_ALGRM , (SELECT T.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_ITEM T WHERE T.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ = A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' AND T.DEL_YN = 'N') MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM , (SELECT T.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_TP FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_ITEM T WHERE T.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ = A.MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_SEQ AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' AND T.DEL_YN = 'N') MODEL_PARAMS_ITEM_TP FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_PARAMS A WHERE A.ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{etc_model_seq} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* file : MakeMetaModelSchedulerMapper.xml, id : setMakeModelFiles */ SELECT * FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_FILES WHERE ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{etc_model_seq} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND REF_TP = 'DATA'
/* file : MakeMetaModelSchedulerMapper.xml, id : getOriginFiles */ SELECT * FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_FILES WHERE ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{etc_model_seq} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND REF_TP = 'DATA'

/* file : MakeMetaModelSchedulerMapper.xml, id : getMakeModelTarget */ SELECT * FROM TB_META_MODEL A WHERE MODEL_ALGRM_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND INDEX_TRGT_COL IS NOT NULL AND MODEL_STATUS = 'WAIT' AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY MDFCN_DT ASC, MODEL_SEQ ASC LIMIT #{limitCnt}

/* file : MakeMetaModelSchedulerMapper.xml, id : setMakeModelFeatureColumns */ SELECT * FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL_COLUMN WHERE ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{etc_model_seq} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND MODEL_COL_TP = 'FC'
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN true ELSE false END AS result FROM TB_META_ETC_MODEL WHERE ETC_MODEL_SEQ = #{model_seq} AND MODEL_STATUS = #{model_status};
